text: [opus-cef] Parts Library → Reverse Engineering handoff seam. I'm adding the PARTS-SIDE push only (host/src/ui/parts/): a "Reverse-engineer this part" action on un-modeled parts that calls reveng_start_session(part_ref=..., research=<part# or vendor URL>) and sets activeWorkspace=ReverseEng. NOT touching reveng_workspace.cpp / RevEngState / the reveng_from_library ribbon button — those are RE-30's scope (Sources selector + adaptive stepper). Seam contract: I set a new additive AppState field `pendingRevengSessionId` (std::string) when the button fires; the RE workspace (RE-30 owner) should consume+clear it on its next draw to auto-select the freshly-created session. MVP works without that pickup (tab switches, new session shows top of list). Whoever takes RE-30: ping me if you'd rather own the parts-side button too, or want a different field name.
